about: What the one who gives an aim says when the fight it leads to is beyond the company, as the company itself reckons it (DangerSense: grave or deadly), and the company goes alone (OR-64, the owner, 17 November: 'way too easy for a starting mage to die … the initial quest-giver could hint you need to get some friends'). {giver} is who gave it; {helper} someone who could go with the company, and {where} where they are. Read by Outmatched.warning; one short sentence or two, said in the giver's voice.
help: {giver} looks you over. ‘Not on your own, you won’t. {helper} at {where} is looking for work: take someone with you.’
alone: {giver} looks you over. ‘Not on your own, you won’t. Find someone to go with you first.’
